title: C reference doc for calc module (sweph.c dispatch + pipeline)
description:
Produce `docs/c-ref-calc.md` by reading the C source (sweph.c). This is the porting reference for the entire calc module — all subsequent implementation sub-tasks depend on it.

Cover these functions with algorithm structure, coefficients, loop logic, unit conversions, boundary handling, and line numbers:

1. `plaus_iflag()` (sweph.c:~200–308) — flag validation/normalization: illegal combos, default ephemeris selection, forced SPEED, body-specific flag adjustments
2. `swe_calc()` entry (sweph.c:309–586) — cache check against savedat, SPEED3 mode (3-call central difference with body-specific dt), result caching
3. `swecalc()` dispatch (sweph.c:587–~1560) — full body routing table, ECL_NUT special case (returns obliquity+nutation), mean node/apogee speed from 2-point difference
4. `main_planet()` (sweph.c:1562–1696) — ephemeris cascade selection, Moshier path to sweplan()
5. `main_planet_bary()` (sweph.c:1697–1819) — raw barycentric without corrections
6. `sweplan()` (sweph.c:1820–1988) — planet+Earth+Moon orchestration, helio→bary conversion, EMB→Earth formula: earth = emb − moon/(EARTH_MOON_MRAT+1), caching per sub-body
7. `app_pos_etc_plan()` (sweph.c:2465–2776) — ICRS→J2000 bias, light-time Newton iteration (t'=t−|Δx|/c, iterations=0 for Moshier), speed correction for changing light-delay, then delegates to app_pos_rest
8. `app_pos_etc_sun()` (sweph.c:~2350–2464) — Sun-specific: geocentric = −(Earth helio), light-time handling, correction path
9. `app_pos_etc_moon()` (sweph.c:~2200–2350) — Moon-specific: no gravitational deflection, aberration differences, speed already from central differences
10. `app_pos_rest()` (sweph.c:2777–~3100) — shared pipeline: aberration→deflection→precession→nutation matrix→ecliptic→sidereal(stub)→polar→units, 4 output slots in xreturn[24]
11. `swi_aberr_light()` (sweph.c:3699–~3740) — Lorentz transform: v in units of c, β=√(1−v²), f₁, f₂ formula, exact coefficients
12. `swi_deflect_light()` (sweph.c:3743–~3830) — GR light bending: g₁, g₂ formula, meff() call, exact coefficients
13. `meff()` (sweph.c:~3830–3900) — effective mass factor: tabulated angle/mass pairs, linear interpolation
14. `swi_mean_node()`, `swi_mean_apog()` — polynomial formulas for mean lunar node and apogee, exact coefficients

Follow the format of existing sibling ref docs (e.g., docs/c-ref-nutation.md). The agent producing this doc should NOT spawn subagents — it reads the C source and writes the doc itself in one context.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/c-ref-calc.md exists and covers all 14 items listed above
Line numbers referenced for each function
Coefficients and formulas extracted verbatim (not paraphrased)
Sufficient detail to implement each function without reading C source
Follows format of existing sibling ref docs
